remarks: Nestled on 2.09 Acres (which are adjoining and already subdivided) in the highly desirable Revonah Woods neighborhood, this spacious 5-bedroom colonial provides tranquility and charm in a peaceful, nature-filled setting. This listing includes 2 subdivided parcels. The house sits on 1.09 acres. Second parcel right next door is on 1 acre, partially wooded. The beautiful property has plenty of room for play, and features a in-ground swimming pool, perfect for relaxation and outdoor enjoyment. Enter into the center hall with the formal living room off to the side. The family is off the back of the house with a bay window to take in the back yard. The main floor includes a bedroom and bath, ideal for guests or a home office. Upstairs, you'll find four generously sized bedrooms and three baths, providing plenty of space for family and guests. Lovingly maintained, this home is ready for your personal updates to transform it into your dream home. A rare opportunity in a coveted location!
